de_seed_rule: The first call of a run covers 16 generations and uses the seed. Each later call covers 8 generations; call k (k = 1, 2, ...) uses seed + k. The Latin-hypercube points of the initial population use the seed.

noise_seeds.rule: Motion i of a set (i = 0, 1, ..., in the order of settings/motions.json) uses first + i. Teacher k (k = 1, 2, 3) adds 10000 * k. Both geometry settings use the same seeds. The generator is numpy.random.default_rng(seed); the groups are drawn in the order of settings/noise.json.

teacher_draw_rule.rule: Seven uniform values of z in the parameter order. An infeasible vector is rejected and all seven values are drawn again with the same generator.

teacher0: The main teacher was drawn once with operating-system entropy. It has no seed; its values are in teacher/teacher0.json.
